cases.title: The Lesson
cases.brief: Training exercise at the Meridian Investigative Academy. A stolen medal. Three suspects. Your first lesson: evidence does not prove guilt — people do.

cases.title: The Missing File
cases.brief: A records clerk is found dead in the County Records Annex and file 2019-1183 is gone from the vault. The county calls it suicide. The vault log disagrees.

cases.title: The Silent Courier
cases.brief: A courier is found unconscious, his delivery missing: a burner phone. Its call log holds a number that will follow you for twenty cases. Phone #8821 enters the record.

cases.title: The Glass House
cases.brief: A food critic collapses at the Veridian table he never got to review. A young waitress named Nina Park sees more than she says. Remember her.

cases.title: The Inheritance
cases.brief: Edward Marsh dies with three heirs and one safe. Inside the safe: a pocket watch engraved with initials that mean nothing to you yet. R.C.

cases.title: The Blue Collar
cases.brief: A maintenance worker dies in a Northbridge Logistics warehouse. The foreman calls it an accident. A quiet forklift operator named Sam Okafor saw nothing. Officially.

cases.title: The Golden Ledger
cases.brief: An accountant who once audited Northbridge Logistics runs, then floats. His ledger lists payments to 'AEGIS — consulting' and one line item he circled twice: client 404.

cases.title: The Paper Trail
cases.brief: A document storage facility burns. Arson, professionally. Among the ashes: a signature you have seen before. Files do not burn themselves.

cases.title: The Recurring Number
cases.brief: An extortion case opens a drawer that should have stayed shut: burner phone #8821, the same number that vanished in CASE 002. Someone is answering it.

cases.title: The Chain of Custody
cases.brief: Evidence disappears from a police lockup between two signed transfers. Detective Marcus Miller warns you: records cases spook people. He has no idea how right he is.

cases.title: The Quiet Partners
cases.brief: Shell companies inside shell companies: Northbridge, Aegis, and a trust with no name. Your first full courtroom duel against Victor Kessler.

cases.title: The Carter File
cases.brief: The watch from CASE 004 resurfaces in a pawn shop. It belonged to Detective Robert Carter — your father — the detective who was erased in 2005.

cases.title: The Long Memory
cases.brief: A witness you treated kindly — or badly — remembers. Alan Bishop resurfaces with a price. Marcus Miller is quietly reassigned for helping you.

cases.title: ERROR 404
cases.brief: The signature appears on erased files across two decades. Then your own phone lights up: STOP INVESTIGATING CASE 13. The game has noticed you.

cases.title: The Fall
cases.brief: Detective Marcus Miller disappears. The only witness is Nina Park — your witness from CASE 003 — and now she is a suspect. Protect her, or bury her.

cases.title: Witness Protection
cases.brief: Sam Okafor finally agrees to talk. So does the man sent to stop him. A parking garage. A countdown. Your keys are in the ignition.

cases.title: The Stolen Truth
cases.brief: The evidence archive is breached and the case that matters most is stolen back. Recover it before the chain of custody breaks forever.

cases.title: The Northbridge File
cases.brief: Shipping manifests expose the pipeline: how evidence moved, how files vanished, who paid. That night, someone is in your apartment.

cases.title: Cold Coffee
cases.brief: Sarah is afraid of something she will not name. Marcus's fate surfaces. And the Records Annex you thought you knew becomes a trap with you inside.

cases.title: The Turncoat
cases.brief: Victor Kessler makes you an offer you were never meant to refuse. Michael Hayes's real role in 2004 comes to light. Decide who you are.

cases.title: The Inheritor
cases.brief: Sam Okafor's maintenance logs prove CASE 005 was murder. The motion to reopen the 2004 archive fire is filed. The Registry reacts.

cases.title: The Broken Vow
cases.brief: The betrayal. Someone you trusted hands the file to the enemy — unless you built a trust strong enough to survive what was asked of them.

cases.title: FILE 404
cases.brief: 2004. Detective Robert Carter found the Registry's founding erasure. They framed him, burned the archive, and deleted his name. The file was never lost. It was waiting.

cases.title: The Final Record
cases.brief: Everything converges in Courtroom 3. Twenty-three cases. One truth. Choose the name you speak — and live with what the record says about you.
